$comment: English strings. Spanish lives in actions.json. The plugin and the MCP server pick the language from config.language ('auto' = system language: Spanish -> es, anything else -> en).

new-session.description: Start a new Claude Code session (Cmd/Ctrl+N)

send.description: Send the typed message (Enter). If Claude is working, it is delivered when the current action finishes.

send-now.description: Stop the current response (Esc) and send what you typed right away (Enter)

accept-suggestion.description: Accept the suggested prompt when the box is empty (Tab)

approve-all.description: Switch the permission mode to 'Accept edits': Claude applies edits without asking one by one

plan-mode.description: Switch the permission mode to 'Plan': Claude researches and proposes a plan without editing code

manual-mode.description: Go back to the 'Manual' permission mode (asks before every change)

model-menu.description: Open the model menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I); pick with 1-9

model-1.description: Select the first configured model (Opus by default)

model-2.description: Select the second configured model (Sonnet by default)

model-3.description: Select the third configured model (Haiku by default)

compact.description: Type and send /compact to summarize the context (use with an empty prompt box)

context.description: Type and send /context to see context usage (use with an empty prompt box)

code-review.description: Type and send /code-review to review the current diff (use with an empty prompt box)

claudeSend.description: A message or command was sent

claudeError.description: An action failed (e.g. missing Accessibility permission)
